description: Define a named Dagster job from a set of asset keys (without scheduling it).

job_name.description: Unique job name shown in the Jobs tab.
job_name.label: Job Name

asset_keys.description: Slash-separated asset keys included in the job. Set this, asset_check_keys, or both.
asset_keys.label: Asset Keys

tags.description: Tags applied to runs of this job.
tags.label: Tags

asset_check_keys.label: Asset Check Keys
asset_check_keys.description: Asset check keys included in the job, as '<asset_key>:<check_name>' (asset key segments slash-separated, e.g. 'marts/orders:row_count_check'). Runs just the check -- via Dagster's real AssetSelection.checks(...), confirmed to execute with zero re-materialization of the parent asset -- for a one-button 'just re-run this check' job. Combine with asset_keys to also materialize assets in the same job.

name: AssetJob
